name: Push Lead (upsert + activity)
summary: Like Sync Leads, but also writes a triggerable activity attributed to a program — the way to start workflows from a lead capture event.
whenToUse: When you want to add/update a lead AND kick off a Smart Campaign or program flow at the same time (e.g. 'downloaded the pricing sheet').

fixed.name: programName
fixed.label: Program name
fixed.hint: The exact program name the activity is attributed to (must already exist in Marketo).

fixed.name: source
fixed.label: Source
fixed.hint: Optional free text stored on the activity, e.g. the website or campaign name.

fixed.name: reason
fixed.label: Reason
fixed.hint: Optional free text stored on the activity, e.g. what the person did.

fixed.name: lookupField
fixed.label: Match existing leads by
fixed.hint: Use mktToken to match by the mkt_tok cookie value instead of a lead field.

response.description: One status per row, plus the activity that was created.

notes: Always performs an upsert — there is no action setting.
To attach prior anonymous web activity to a new lead, put the mkt_tok value in an 'mktToken' column of that row.
The program must exist in the same workspace.
